references.text: Gamaliel, son of Pedahzur, is first mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Manasseh in the census.
Gamaliel, son of Pedahzur, is named as the leader of the tribe of Manasseh in the camp arrangement.
Gamaliel, son of Pedahzur, brought his offering as prince of the children of Manasseh on the eighth day.
The preceding verse describes the departure of Ephraim, when Manasseh belonged to Ephraim's camp.
Manasseh was Joseph's firstborn son, and the tribe was named after him.
Jacob adopted Ephraim and Manasseh as his own sons, establishing them as separate tribes.
